summary: Scattered individual posts include a Mumbai news share on a 31-year-old duped of ₹9 lakh in a Google Meet KYC scam, a direct complaint to Reliance Jio about unreceived recharge and service, and one user's report of ₹82k unauthorized UPI fraud via Google Pay on Canara Bank. A few recovery spam accounts mention BitBNS or crypto issues, with no widespread conversation or notable volume.
